machine.description: Wentylator spalin kotła, napęd przez sprzęgło kłowe
machine.setup: motor – jaw coupling (elastomer insert) – fan; fan rotor supported on both sides (between bearings); motor bearings: ball (NDE) and cylindrical roller (DE, coupling side); fan bearings: double-row spherical roller

state.units: vibration velocity mm/s RMS; phase in degrees; spectrum keys are multiples of running speed

phase_across_coupling_motor_DE_to_fan_DE.note: fan_DE phase is averaged from unstable repeated readings if phase_1x_instability_std_deg is high

state.technician_notes: Temperatura obudowy łożyska wentylatora od strony sprzęgła 71 °C, od strony przeciwnej 62 °C. Obsługa zgłasza okresowe stuki. Łożysko wentylatora od strony sprzęgła wymieniano 18 miesięcy temu (osadzone na tulei zaciskowej). Obwiednia 2–10 kHz: brak prążków BPFO/BPFI/BSF/FTF, podwyższony poziom szerokopasmowy na tym łożysku. Wirnik wentylatora czyszczono 3 miesiące temu. Śruby kotwiące kontrolowano rok temu.

looseness.instructions: Use the order spectra of all four points in `measurement_points` (including half-orders 0.5x, 1.5x, 2.5x), their `computed_indicators`, the repeated 1x phase readings, the vertical 1x amplitude/phase across joints (housing → pedestal → frame → foundation), the time-waveform indicators, the noise floor, the phase across the coupling and `technician_notes`. Does the vibration pattern indicate mechanical looseness (loose or worn fit, loose mounting, structural weakness)?

criteria.true: Long series of integer harmonics of running speed (1x…8x or more), often with half-order components (0.5x, 1.5x, 2.5x), raised noise floor, unstable 1x phase between repeated measurements, and/or ~180 deg vertical 1x phase shift across a joint (foot, base plate, frame, foundation).
criteria.false: Few harmonics, stable phase, no half-orders and no phase reversal across joints; pattern is better explained by another single fault.

looseness_type.instructions: Use the order spectra of all four points in `measurement_points` (including half-orders 0.5x, 1.5x, 2.5x), their `computed_indicators`, the repeated 1x phase readings, the vertical 1x amplitude/phase across joints (housing → pedestal → frame → foundation), the time-waveform indicators, the noise floor, the phase across the coupling and `technician_notes`. Which type of looseness best matches the pattern?

criteria.structural_foundation: Type A: weak or loose feet, base plate, frame or foundation; dominant 1x (sometimes 2x) in the loose direction, ~180 deg vertical 1x phase shift across the loose joint, no long harmonic series.
criteria.bearing_pedestal_or_frame: Type B: loose pedestal or housing bolts, cracked frame or bearing support; 1x and 2x with a few harmonics, directional or unstable phase.
criteria.rotating_fit: Type C: loose or worn fit of a bearing or rotating component – bearing ring or adapter sleeve loose in housing or on shaft, excessive bearing clearance, loose impeller hub; long series of harmonics, half-order components, raised noise floor, erratic phase.

location.instructions: Use the order spectra of all four points in `measurement_points` (including half-orders 0.5x, 1.5x, 2.5x), their `computed_indicators`, the repeated 1x phase readings, the vertical 1x amplitude/phase across joints (housing → pedestal → frame → foundation), the time-waveform indicators, the noise floor, the phase across the coupling and `technician_notes`. Where is the looseness located?

criteria.motor_NDE: Strongest looseness signature (longest harmonic series, half-order components, unstable phase) is at motor_NDE (ball bearing).
criteria.motor_DE: Strongest looseness signature (longest harmonic series, half-order components, unstable phase) is at motor_DE (cylindrical roller bearing).
criteria.fan_DE: Strongest looseness signature (longest harmonic series, half-order components, unstable phase) is at fan_DE (double-row spherical roller bearing (self-aligning)).
criteria.fan_NDE: Strongest looseness signature (longest harmonic series, half-order components, unstable phase) is at fan_NDE (double-row spherical roller bearing (self-aligning)).
criteria.none: No point shows a looseness signature.

alt_misalignment_or_coupling_wear.instructions: Use the order spectra of all four points in `measurement_points` (including half-orders 0.5x, 1.5x, 2.5x), their `computed_indicators`, the repeated 1x phase readings, the vertical 1x amplitude/phase across joints (housing → pedestal → frame → foundation), the time-waveform indicators, the noise floor, the phase across the coupling and `technician_notes`. Is misalignment or jaw-coupling wear/backlash a more likely main cause than looseness (high 2x relative to 1x, high axial vibration, ~180 deg 1x phase shift across the coupling, symptoms strongest at the coupling-side bearings of both machines)?

alt_bearing_defect.instructions: Use the order spectra of all four points in `measurement_points` (including half-orders 0.5x, 1.5x, 2.5x), their `computed_indicators`, the repeated 1x phase readings, the vertical 1x amplitude/phase across joints (housing → pedestal → frame → foundation), the time-waveform indicators, the noise floor, the phase across the coupling and `technician_notes`. Is a rolling-bearing defect a more likely explanation (discrete bearing defect frequencies with harmonics and sidebands in the envelope spectrum; see `technician_notes`)?

alt_rotor_stator_rub.instructions: Use the order spectra of all four points in `measurement_points` (including half-orders 0.5x, 1.5x, 2.5x), their `computed_indicators`, the repeated 1x phase readings, the vertical 1x amplitude/phase across joints (housing → pedestal → frame → foundation), the time-waveform indicators, the noise floor, the phase across the coupling and `technician_notes`. Is a rotor–stator rub (e.g. fan wheel against casing or inlet cone) a plausible cause (harmonics and half-orders with erratic amplitude)?

alt_unbalance.instructions: Use the order spectra of all four points in `measurement_points` (including half-orders 0.5x, 1.5x, 2.5x), their `computed_indicators`, the repeated 1x phase readings, the vertical 1x amplitude/phase across joints (housing → pedestal → frame → foundation), the time-waveform indicators, the noise floor, the phase across the coupling and `technician_notes`. Is unbalance (e.g. build-up on the fan wheel) the primary cause of the high vibration instead of looseness?

severity.instructions: Use the order spectra of all four points in `measurement_points` (including half-orders 0.5x, 1.5x, 2.5x), their `computed_indicators`, the repeated 1x phase readings, the vertical 1x amplitude/phase across joints (housing → pedestal → frame → foundation), the time-waveform indicators, the noise floor, the phase across the coupling and `technician_notes`. How serious is the condition, considering vibration level, ISO zone, temperature and waveform?
criteria: 1 – Slight: few harmonics, no half-orders, vibration in ISO zone A/B.
2 – Moderate: harmonic series with some half-order components or unstable phase, zone B/C; inspect at the next planned stop.
3 – Serious: long harmonic series with half-orders, raised noise floor, zone C, raised bearing temperature; inspect soon and limit operating time.
4 – Critical: zone D or impacting/truncated waveform, risk of component failure; stop and inspect.

action.instructions: Use the order spectra of all four points in `measurement_points` (including half-orders 0.5x, 1.5x, 2.5x), their `computed_indicators`, the repeated 1x phase readings, the vertical 1x amplitude/phase across joints (housing → pedestal → frame → foundation), the time-waveform indicators, the noise floor, the phase across the coupling and `technician_notes`. What is the most appropriate next action?

criteria.continue_monitoring: No looseness or only slight signs; keep the normal measurement interval.
criteria.tighten_and_check_mounting: Check and torque foot, base plate and pedestal bolts, grouting and frame cracks; re-measure (types A and B).
criteria.inspect_bearing_seat_and_clearance: Inspect bearing housing bore, shaft seat, adapter or withdrawal sleeve and lock nut, outer-ring creep; measure bearing radial clearance (type C).
criteria.inspect_coupling_and_alignment: Check jaw-coupling insert wear and backlash and re-check alignment.
criteria.stop_and_inspect: Stop the fan as soon as the process allows and inspect (critical condition).
criteria.investigate_other_cause: Pattern points to another fault; diagnose before maintenance on mounting or bearings.
